visualEvidenceBoundary: Automatic counters are not human visual verdicts. Screenshot/human observations and iOS cloud reports are described separately in the checkpoint document.
knownWarnings: Raw originals retained unchanged, including all errors/warnings; only counts and scoped findings enter this record.
